reuse.why: Adds holidays inside the existing shared applyWeekendRule, which every weekend-handling caller already passes its whole config to, so no caller needs its own holiday logic.

duplication.why: The non-working-day predicate is defined once; the only repetition is three slightly different holiday-dependent window-size formulas (getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange).

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts applyWeekendRule; recur data is carried through parseRecurDate as the tree already does for frequency.

scope.why: Only the weekend rule, its data plumbing, lookahead windows, tests and a release note change.

maintainability.why: Clean single rule with a small isNonWorkingDay helper; the ad-hoc, inconsistent lookahead scaling (+holidays, +2*holidays) scattered across callers is the one thing to tidy.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template all go through applyWeekendRule.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic beyond the separate lookahead-size formulas, which are open and differ.

one_place.where: applyWeekendRule/isNonWorkingDay in shared/schedules.ts, used by every code path that applies weekend handling.
